name: Settra the Imperishable
canonNotes: King of Kings and ruler of Khemri, the mightiest and most ruthless Tomb King, whose will is so strong he never returns to his sarcophagus.
Considers all other realms upstarts and all rulers his rightful vassals.
voiceNotes: Utterly imperious and grandiloquent; speaks in titles and decrees.
Demands submission; mortal kings are beneath him.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
